**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Prove native receive activity before closing**

Starting receive and observing only `snapshot.receiving` does not establish that a native callback or worker operation is active; this host is closed immediately without sending loopback traffic or waiting for a receive counter to advance. The later `rx_callbacks` value comes from the separate send host, so the claimed receive-active shutdown can pass without exercising shutdown against any receive activity. Wait for measurable native/delivered receive activity before closing the receive host.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L12-L12](https://github.com/sscheidl/TAUREON-Synth-Tool-V4/blob/7dc09c9bd241cb773b25b41402d1aea892926d3f/AGENTS.md#L12-L12)

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject shutdowns that do not reach the closed state**

For the receive/send-active cases, `ConnectionWorker::run()` discards the result of its teardown `disconnect()`, while this assertion records neither that result nor `inner_->state()`. Consequently, a native close that returns an error or leaves the transport in `failed` can still satisfy destruction, close-count, and diagnostic assertions and be reported as a successful lifecycle shutdown. Record and require successful close with final `TransportState::closed`.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L12-L12](https://github.com/sscheidl/TAUREON-Synth-Tool-V4/blob/7dc09c9bd241cb773b25b41402d1aea892926d3f/AGENTS.md#L12-L12)

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep B-3 open until apartment evidence is captured**

This marks B-3 as passing even though the new harness never observes or reports the GUI main-thread apartment model or WMS apartment initialization (there is no `CoGetApartmentType`-style check or equivalent recorded evidence). Section 15.4 of the Stage 5 brief explicitly requires apartment initialization in the product-host report, so successful construction/enumeration alone cannot close the apartment portion of this gate.
